items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you hear of someone called Frankie Half-Pint Jackson, did you know him? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Half-Pint.

ctx.x: Well, I just remember just about how many people would go in there. Just like the Dream Land. Three hundred, something like that? Oh, easy. Oh, that's easy, sure. Dream Land, now Dream Land had a balcony. People had a balcony, they had upstairs. Then right in the center, there was a big glass, it was right in the middle of the floor, you know. Because a spotlight comes upon it. That way, at least the hill used to get over there and do the shimmy. Over that glass, big light comes up right out, you stand right over…
Did you hear of someone called Frankie Half-Pint Jackson, did you know him? Who? Half-Pint Jackson in Chicago, an entertainer, dancer.
